title: El Pipián de Tlaxcala, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: pipian-tlaxcala (MAJESTIC): comedor de una casona familiar en Tlaxcala, comida del domingo. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.CRISTINA_ARRIAGA: Mexican matriarch from Tlaxcala, owner of a famous restaurant, 66 years old, fair skin, short silver hair styled with volume, gold-rimmed glasses on a chain, a burgundy silk blouse, a black skirt, a big gold brooch, black low heels, her hands empty.
chars.SOFIA_JUAREZ: Mexican woman from Tlaxcala, 30 years old, brown skin, long black hair in a side braid, small silver earrings, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a white blouse, dark jeans, flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.EMILIO_ARRIAGA: Mexican man, 34 years old, fair skin, short curly brown hair, clean-shaven, a light-blue sweater over a white collared shirt, grey trousers, brown shoes, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_COMEDORTLAXCALA: Dining room of a large old family house in Tlaxcala at midday on a Sunday: a long dark wooden table with clay dishes and talavera plates, a pot of green pipián sauce, wooden chairs, white walls with old family photos without readable text, a window to a garden, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
